title: I’m prototyping a persistent AI-driven world where NPCs and factions have memory, lineage, and consequences. Looking for people interested in AI + game systems to test or collaborate.
author: Efficient-Peanut-783
selftext:
I’m working on a small prototype for a game/world where NPCs and factions have persistent memory, lineage, and consequences.

Instead of scripted stories, the world evolves through AI-driven agents: leaders remember betrayals, families inherit reputations, wars and trade affect future generations, and nothing resets when a character dies.

Right now I’m starting with a minimal backend (Python + AI + persistence) before plugging it into a game engine like Unreal later.

I’m looking for a few people who enjoy building systems — AI, game logic, simulation, or Unreal — to test ideas, share feedback, or potentially collaborate as this prototype grows.

This isn’t a crypto/NFT project or a hype thing — just an experiment in persistent, consequence-driven worlds.
